tools.name: audit_site
tools.description: Audit one public web page with 69 checks across security, SEO, TLS, performance, transport, accessibility, links, mobile, DNS and agent readiness. Returns the score, grade and the problems found, most important first, each with an exact fix, plus an audit_id to pass to verify_fixes after changes. Pa

tools.name: verify_fixes
tools.description: Run a fresh audit of the same site and compare it with an earlier audit: lists what was fixed, improved, still failing, worse or new, with the score before and after. Use after making changes suggested by audit_site. Counts as one of the 5 free daily audits.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List every check AgentSiteAudit runs: its ID, category, severity and what it looks for, plus the category weights. Free and unlimited.
